notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association inventory is sourced: type Ground, status Gone, coordinates. The record's kind 'ground', status and coordinates match the inventory; no correction. Two web searches found no history of a lookout at Guaje Mountain, and no fetched page gives a build date, builder or design, so none is stated. Do not confuse with the NRHP entry 'Guaje Site' (NRIS 82001049), an aboriginal archaeological site with a restricted address; it is unrelated and was not used. Records worth checking: Santa Fe National Forest and Los Alamos historical records.
